name: ATTENTION
description: A queer play about why and how we choose to pay attention. Co-created by acclaimed director Jules Head and Bruntwood Prize shortlisted writer Georgia Bruce.

name: Audio Description Headset
description: This performance is Audio Described. Would you like to pre-book your Audio Description headset for this show?

name: Captioning Facilities
description: Let us know if you would like to use the Captioning facilities so we can ensure you're in the right seats.

name: Darkling
description: She was born under a blue sky in a city of lakes. Then comes the night that tears everything apart. Ferocious, brutal and damning, this epic story of a life ravaged by ecological disaster is written by Titas Halder.

name: Global Majority
description: A chair, a candidate, a thousand eyes. Black Mirror meets Succession in this tale of twisted family loyalty, cabalistic elites, and what we sacrifice for proximity to power. From Tony Craze award-winning writer Chris Fung.

name: Insane Asylum Seekers
description: “Worth the hype” (Broadway World). Insane Asylum Seekers transfers to the Bush Theatre’s main stage following a sold-out Studio run. Written by Laith Elzubaidi and directed by Olivier Award-nominee Emily Ling Williams.

name: Pre-order Drinks
description: Pre-order your drinks now to skip the bar queue and save 20%.

name: Ripples
description: Lost in a world of surveillance and suspicion, one man fights to hold on to who he is and right this wrong. An urgent and electrifying interrogation of Britain’s treatment of migrants and the relentless power of hope.

name: The Bridge
description: Palestinian actor and comedian Alaa Shehada returns following his heartfelt and hilarious Scotsman Fringe First winning debut, The Horse of Jenin.

name: The Hungry Ghost
description: A sexy horror rom-com exploring what takes root in the space between superstition and rationality. Starring Olivier Award nominee Mei Mac and Bridgerton's Isabella Wei.

name: Touch Tour
description: Touch Tours are aimed at blind and visually impaired patrons, allowing you to familiarise yourself with the set and costumes and meet the cast.
